comments: The drawing is wider than the 4 to 3 canvas, so the importer letterboxes it: 128x57, bottom-aligned. The rules' ridge is a box 6 units wide and 11 high; this picture cannot fill that without a stretch the importer does not do. Imported and left off.
geometry: A ridge a bomber hides behind; the rules own its box and judge every scrape; art never sets a hitbox (none).
mapping_basis: Visual review of the delivered drawing, 2026-10-19: three crags with strata ledges and moss, drawn 2.24 to 1.
timing: idle 1 ticks (30 Hz). Durations are the rules' and live in assets/griffinwing/slots.json.
